item.title: Interactive advent calendar launched as homeless charity bids to raise £80,000
item.description: Southampton homelessness charity The Society of St James is launching its £80,000 Christmas appeal with an online interactive advent calendar.

item.title: Pensioner, 72, drove on M3 without wearing a seatbelt - In the Dock
item.description: These among the latest criminals to appear in a Southampton court

item.title: Fury as planners recommend 245 homes should be built
item.description: Campaigners against the building of 245 homes in Eastleigh are “aghast” and shocked that planners have recommended the scheme to go ahead.

item.title: The tragic story behind the name of residential Southampton street
item.description: One local road of particular interest is Hulse Road, the tale behind the name can be traced to a single incident in 1856.

item.title: M3 and M27 closures for Southampton drivers to be aware of this weekend
item.description: Southampton drivers will need to be aware of a couple of closures on the M3 and M27 for the weekend of December 5 to 7

item.title: Innovative book subscription service honoured at Downing Street
item.description: Romsey based children's book subscription box ZaZa’s Storybox has been named one of the UK's 100 most inspiring small businesses.

item.title: 'Miracle' French bulldog puppy recovers from heart surgery
item.description: French bulldog puppy Gigi is recovering after life-saving heart surgery for pulmonary stenosis at Anderson Moores Veterinary Specialists in Winchester.

item.title: Southampton pub 'dehumanised' disabled woman after demanding she leave
item.description: A family say they were left “dehumanised” after being ordered to leave a Southampton pub because of an assistance dog.

item.title: What we know so far as murder investigation underway in Portswood
item.description: A murder investigation is underway after a man died on Belmont Road on Wednesday night, prompting shock among long-standing residents.

item.title: Taste of China loses late license after repeatedly hiring illegal staff
item.description: A Chinese restaurant in Southampton has had its late-night licence revoked after immigration officers repeatedly found illegal workers inside over several years.
